# 

> The lease protocol (the exact port of lease.sh v2, golden-tested
> against a frozen reference) and the git-state materializer, as a
> plain-Java JPMS library with no IDE dependency — one core, thin
> hosts (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1057, #1067). The IntelliJ plugin
> embeds it; lease.sh execs its CLIs; the ws: goals may depend on it
> directly, which is what retires the goal-to-$HOME-script coupling
> (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1005).
